a global service network ensure maximum availability whenever it is required.
Pressure-resistant and gas-tight crankcase for high-pressure noble gas compressors
The stress-optimized, gas-tight crankcase is designed to safely withstand internal and inlet pressures. Its pressure-resistant structure prevents leakage and reduces mechanical stress, extending service life and ensuring reliable long-term operation when compressing helium, argon, and other noble gases.
Maximum tightness for noble gas and process gas
applications
Gas-tight BAUER industrial compressors for helium and argon achieve leakage rates below 0.1 mbar·l/s. This enables extremely low-loss process gas compression and maximum purity for stable processes – ideal for laboratory applications, semiconductor manufacturing, and industrial noble gas applications.
